title: Recon Optimisation
body:
### 1. Comparing TW & YY nucleosome recon

| Time | Incubation | **TW recon:** addition | TW volume | TW KCl | **YY recon:** addition | YY volume | YY KCl |
|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|
| 0 min | 30 min | 5 µL DNA + 1.5 µL octamer added to dried KCl | 6.5 µL | **1.769 M** | 5 µL DNA + 1.5 µL octamer added to dried KCl | 6.5 µL | **1.769 M** |
| 30 min | 60 min | +5.0 µL DB | 11.5 µL | **1.000 M** | +2.5 µL DB | 9.0 µL | **1.278 M** |
| 90 min | 60 min | +2.5 µL DB | 14.0 µL | **0.821 M** | +2.5 µL DB | 11.5 µL | **1.000 M** |
| 150 min | 60 min | +2.5 µL DB | 16.5 µL | **0.697 M** | +2.5 µL DB | 14.0 µL | **0.821 M** |
| 210 min | 60 min | +3.5 µL DB | 20.0 µL | **0.575 M** | +2.5 µL DB | 16.5 µL | **0.697 M** |
| 270 min | 60 min | +3.5 µL DB | 23.5 µL | **0.489 M** | +2.5 µL DB | 19.0 µL | **0.605 M** |
| 330 min | 60 min | +30.0 µL DB | 53.5 µL | **0.215 M** | +32.5 µL DB | 51.5 µL | **0.223 M** |
| 390 min | 60 min | +15.0 µL DB | 68.5 µL | **0.168 M** | +50.0 µL DB | 101.5 µL | **0.113 M** |
| 450 min | End | — | 68.5 µL | **168 mM** | — | 101.5 µL | **113 mM** |

Initial DNA added = 100 ng
Initial octamer added = 121.5 ng

Octamer Stock = Prepare 25 uL (81 ng/uL) => 0.44 uL octamer stock + 0.75 uL 100 mM TCEP + 23.81 uL refolding buffer:glycerol

Octamer:DNA ratio in both experiments = 1.005:1

*NOTE: DNA was taken from well H1 of lig147 C0 spare plate*

Post-recon samples are stored at 4 C.
